title: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
subtitle: A fully cooperative campaign of tactical combat in the city of Gloomhaven
tagline: Uncover the sinister plot behind the missing citizens
loreSummary: You are a member of the Jaws of the Lion, an infamous mercenary group in the squalid underbelly of Gloomhaven. What begins as a simple investigation quickly spirals into a fight for the city's very soul.
keyFeatures: Card-driven deterministic combat (No dice, pure tactical strategy)
Accessible tutorial scenarios for an easy learning curve
Storybook-based gameplay (play directly in the book)
Prequel campaign set before the events of Gloomhaven

core_campaign.description: The main storyline arc to the final boss.
